datasets.title: AVS-QA
datasets.description: A comprehensive multimodal dataset combining audio, video, and sensor data with question-answer pairs for cross-modal understanding research.

datasets.title: SensorCap
datasets.description: LLM-assisted softly-labelled IMU sensor data captioning dataset with feature summarizations and narrations of human activities.

datasets.title: OpenSQA
datasets.description: Open-source sensor-aware question-answering or instruction-tuning dataset covering IMU data interpretations for human activities.

datasets.title: LargeSet: Sound Source Localization
datasets.description: Large-scale dataset for multichannel sound source localization research with diverse acoustic scenarios and precise ground truth localization information.

models.title: RAVEN: Multimodal Reasoning
models.description: State-of-the-art multimodal reasoning model combining audio, video, and sensor data for comprehensive scene understanding and cross-modal reasoning.

models.title: LLaSA: Sensor-Language Model
models.description: Specialized language model fine-tuned for sensor data interpretation and natural language generation, bridging sensors and human-understandable descriptions.
